evidence.title: Prime Data Centers Breaks Ground on Three Buildings at its 240MW Campus in Phoenix, Advancing $3B Investment in Avondale
evidence.excerpt: Prime Data Centers reports that it broke ground on the first three buildings at PHX01 in Avondale; each building is assigned 48 MW of critical IT load capacity.

metadata.status_scope: Prime says it broke ground on the first three PHX01 data centers. This supports one generic current-phase project under_construction observation, not three independently modeled projects, a more specific physical stage, commissioning, completion, or operation.
